definition: Translated is an Italian language technology and localization company headquartered in Rome.
details: Founded in 1999 by Marco Trombetti and Isabelle Andrieu, the company develops machine translation, multilingual AI, and localization technologies combining automated translation with human revision. Its platforms support context-aware localization and AI-assisted translation workflows.

explainer.lead: Translated is an Italian language technology and localization company based in Rome, founded in 1999 by Marco Trombetti and Isabelle Andrieu. It matters as a provider combining automated translation with human revision.

tiers.eli5: It is a company that builds translation software and combines machines doing the first pass with people checking the result.
tiers.practitioner: Its platforms support context-aware localization and AI-assisted translation workflows in which automated output is revised by humans. The pitfall inherent to this model is reliance on the human revision stage for final quality.
tiers.paperLevel: No formal definition applies; it is an organization. It develops machine translation, multilingual AI and localization technologies combining automated translation with human revision.

explainer.example: A localization workflow produces machine translation output that a human reviser then corrects before delivery.
